products.title: Artisan Rectangular Vault | Handwoven Cane Storage Box with Lattice Lid | GrassCrafts
products.descriptionHtml:
The Artisan Rectangular Vault — A Handwoven Cane Box for the Objects That Define You

There is a category of object that exists not merely to store, but to honour. The Artisan Rectangular Vault is one such object. Hand-braided over several days by master artisans in rural India, its lattice lid and precisely structured rectangular form bring geometric order and organic warmth to any surface they occupy.

At 8" × 5" × 2.8", it is sized with intention — generous enough to hold the objects that matter most, refined enough to sit on a lacquered desk, a marble nightstand, or a bespoke dressing table without demanding attention it hasn’t earned.

Cane: A Carbon Story in Every Braid

Cane (rattan) is one of the fastest-growing plants on earth, sequestering carbon throughout its growth cycle at rates that outpace most timber species. When harvested sustainably and woven entirely by hand — without industrial machinery, synthetic adhesives, or fossil-fuel-derived finishes — it becomes one of the most carbon-efficient materials in the luxury home and accessories market.

Choosing this vault means:

  • 85–90% lower embodied carbon compared to petroleum-derived synthetic storage alternatives
  • Biogenic carbon storage — cane actively sequesters CO₂ during its growth cycle
  • 100% biodegradable and fully compostable at end of life — zero microplastics, zero landfill burden
  • Manual craftsmanship — no energy-intensive industrial machinery, no fossil-fuel-powered production
  • Supporting artisan livelihoods built on near-zero-emission, community-based craft economies

Crafted for Those Who Choose with Precision

  • 100% natural cane (rattan) — sustainably harvested, chemical-free, biodegradable
  • Lattice lid — hand-braided with geometric precision, functional and sculptural
  • Rectangular form — 8" L × 5" W × 2.8" H — sized for the objects that define a considered life
  • 200g — lightweight yet structurally sound
  • Hand-braided over several days — no assembly lines, only the rhythmic precision of hand and fibre
  • Each piece is unique — variation in weave is the signature of authentic craft

What It Holds

  • Luxury eyewear — frames that deserve a home as considered as they are
  • Fountain pens, leather-bound journals, and precision stationery
  • Heirloom watches, cufflinks, and silk pocket squares
  • Botanical accents, crystals, or curated mementos of significance

Where It Belongs

  • Bespoke dressing room — for the accessories that complete the look
  • Private study or library — for the instruments of a considered mind
  • Master bathroom — for grooming essentials of the highest order
  • Bedside table — for the objects that begin and end each day

products.descriptionHtml:
Handwoven Cane Ottoman — Where Ancient Craft Meets Conscious Living

Some seats carry more than weight. This one carries a story.

In a quiet Indian workshop, an artisan selects strands of solid, premium-grade cane — not hollow, not composite — and begins the slow, meditative work of weaving. The signature spiral seat emerges over 6–8 hours of skilled handwork, each curve deliberate, each strand placed with the confidence of a craft passed down through generations.

The result is an ottoman that is as structurally sound as it is beautiful.

Why Cane. Why Now.

Cane is one of the earth’s most regenerative materials — and one of the most powerful tools against climate change hiding in plain sight. As it grows, cane actively pulls CO₂ from the atmosphere, storing it within its fibres. It matures in 3–5 years (versus decades for timber), requires no pesticides, and regenerates from its own root system without replanting.

The result: every ottoman you bring home has already offset more carbon than it will ever produce — making it a carbon-negative product from harvest to your living room.

  • 100% solid natural cane — no hollow cores, no plastics, no resins
  • Biodegradable at end of life — returns to the earth as it came
  • Sustainably harvested from managed groves
  • Zero synthetic finishes or chemical treatments
  • Every piece supports fair wages and living craft traditions in India

Choosing this ottoman is a quiet, powerful act — one that measurably reduces your home’s carbon footprint without asking you to compromise on beauty, comfort, or craft.

At Home in the Most Considered Spaces

This is a piece for rooms where nothing is accidental. Tuck it beside a low sofa in your Worli sea-view apartment. Place it on a shaded Lutyens’ Delhi verandah. Let it anchor a reading corner in your Whitefield villa. It belongs wherever slowness is valued and craft is understood.

The earthy tone and tight spiral weave pair beautifully with linen, jute, raw wood, stone, and aged brass. It works as floor seating, a side table, a plant stand, or simply as an object worth looking at.

products.descriptionHtml:
Your Walls Deserve Better Than a Plastic Shelf.

Most storage solutions are an afterthought — functional, forgettable, and ugly. This Water Hyacinth Wall & Vanity Organiser is different. Its dense, hand-braided weave gives it the warmth of a craft object and the utility of a serious storage piece. Three Ways to Use It

  • Wall-mounted kitchen organiser — hang with jute rope or wall hooks; holds spice jars, utensils, condiment bottles, and sachets
  • Bathroom vanity tray — sits flat on marble or stone countertops; perfect for skincare bottles, rolled towels, and grooming essentials
  • Balcony or garden hanging basket — suspend from hooks to store herb pots, dried flowers, scissors, and garden tools

Why It Works

  • Dense braid weave — structured and sturdy; holds shape without sagging
  • Naturally moisture-resistant — wipe-clean surface, suited for bathroom and kitchen environments
  • Versatile mounting: flat base for countertop use, rope-ready for wall hanging
  • 100% natural water hyacinth — sustainable, biodegradable, zero plastic
  • Merges traditional Indian grasscrafts with a modern minimalist aesthetic
  • Each basket is uniquely hand-woven — no two are identical

Dimensions

14" L × 10" H × 7" W

Free shipping on orders above ₹1,250.

Care Instructions

  • Wipe clean with a dry or slightly damp cloth — avoid soaking or submerging in water
  • Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the natural colour
  • Store in a dry, well-ventilated space when not in use
  • Reshape gently if needed — the natural fibres respond well to light misting and air-drying
  • If wall-mounting, use hooks rated for at least 2kg; jute rope is included for hanging

Frequently Asked Questions

Can this be wall-mounted?
Yes — the basket is designed for wall hanging. Use two sturdy hooks (included jute rope loops make it easy) or mount directly on a rail. It's shown in our images hung in a kitchen and on a balcony wall.

Is it suitable for a bathroom vanity?
Absolutely. The dense braid weave is naturally moisture-resistant, making it well-suited for bathroom countertops. Avoid leaving it in standing water or directly under a shower spray.

What can I store in it?
Skincare bottles, rolled hand towels, spice jars, utensils, herb pots, dried flowers, stationery, remote controls — it handles daily-use items beautifully in any room.

What are the dimensions?
14" L × 10" H × 7" W — a generous size that holds more than it looks. The structured walls keep contents upright and accessible.

Is it the same as the Heritage Basket?
No. The Heritage Basket uses an open-weave pattern and is designed as a gift hamper vessel. This organiser uses a dense braid weave, is larger (14×10×7 vs 12×9×5), and is purpose-built for wall mounting and everyday storage.

Is water hyacinth sustainable?
Yes. Water hyacinth is an invasive aquatic plant — harvesting it for craft actually helps restore local ecosystems. Our baskets divert approximately 850g of plant matter that would otherwise choke waterways, while saving an estimated 2,400 litres of water compared to conventional materials.
